mapper.select: SELECT * FROM follow WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followed_id = #{followedId}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.role, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, u.college, u.grade, u.status FROM follow f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.followed_id = u.id WHERE f.follower_id = #{followerId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.role, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, u.college, u.grade, u.status FROM follow f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.follower_id = u.id WHERE f.followed_id = #{followedId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
